client_brief:
Give a small harbour hotel a distinct look without losing room accuracy

Nordhaven occupies a harbour warehouse with fourteen rooms. We want a distinctive image treatment for the brand, while keeping one room hero true to colour so guests can see what they are booking.

Please prepare
- Harbour hotel booking hero: 1 named export. The scene is the supplied Nordhaven property: the guest-room frame from the shoot that shows the whole bed and its linen. The booking action is clear: our name, Nordhaven, and one line asking the guest to book direct with us; any rate shown with it is the pictured room's own nightly rate from nordhaven_rooms.csv, not our general $600 a night band.
- Hotel amenity panel: 1 named export. The named amenities are the three in our brand note, the carafe, the robe and the brass key fob, each cut out from its own supplied photograph and set on our near-black ground. The information is easy to scan.
- Hotel room campaign: 14 named exports. The room photograph matches this room category, and the card carries that room's name, floor and bed label, view line and nightly rate from nordhaven_rooms.csv. The advertised rate preserves its supplied conditions: it keeps any per-night wording its row in nordhaven_rooms.csv carries and adds no from, discount or offer wording.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: A room with the harbour in it
brand_identity.sector: A fourteen-room design-led micro-hotel in a converted harbour warehouse, sold direct.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Opened 2023 on the Nordhavn waterfront, Copenhagen; fourteen rooms run by one small owner-led team.
brand_identity.about: Nordhaven is a fourteen-room hotel inside a converted brick and timber warehouse on the working harbour. We sell the feeling of the building: cold light, plaster, oak and brass. Guests choose us because the place looks like nowhere else, and everything we make has to carry that.
brand_identity.audience: Design-literate urban travellers, 30 to 45, who choose a property on aesthetic and book direct once they trust the point of view.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Six hundred dollars a night, direct only, positioned above the travel-platform grid as a design destination rather than a room count.

palette.name: Near-black ink
palette.usage: The ground of the booking hero and the amenity panel, as the brand note fixes it, and the field behind every room name; also the ink for any type set on a Limewash plaster panel, as on nordhaven_room_card_2025.pdf.

palette.name: Limewash plaster
palette.usage: Every room name and all other type set on Near-black ink; also the one other permitted ground or panel, as on nordhaven_room_card_2025.pdf, where the type on it is Near-black ink.

palette.name: Harbour slate
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and icons only. Never a ground, a panel or any type.

palette.name: Oak
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and icons only. Never a ground, a panel or any type.

palette.name: Brass
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and icons only. Never a ground, a panel or any type.

brand_identity.typography: Nordhaven runs Zodiak Light for display and Söhne for text. Step 01, display and H1, is Zodiak Light at 96 px on 101 px, tracked minus 10 units: the one word room name in limewash on near black, with its floor and bed label locked directly beneath in Söhne Medium caps at 18 px on 22 px tracked 220 units, a fifth the size; the same name runs 72 px on 76 px in the room list. Step 02, the subheading, is Zodiak Light at 56 px on 62 px, tracked minus 5 units, the amenity heading. Step 03, body, is Söhne Regular at 24 px on 36 px, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters, covering supporting lines, running text and amenities. Step 04, fine print, is Söhne Regular at 18 px on 26 px, tracked plus 20 units, and carries the rate. A rate is never set larger than its room name.
brand_identity.voice: Spare, understated, first person, no exclamation. Example line: 'Fourteen rooms on the water. We open direct booking this autumn.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We work from a short brand note that fixes the near-black ground, the placements and the delivered sizes. There is no full guideline system yet, and the room list changes each season.
brand_identity.values: One committed tone across everything, with the true-colour main room photograph kept as the single deliberate exception so guests see the actual bed and linen.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: A one word room name in limewash on near black at 96 px with its floor and bed label locked directly beneath in tracked grotesque caps at 18 px, a fifth the size, so the drop between them is the first thing a viewer notices.

type_system.tagline: A room with the harbour in it

scale.note: The one word room name, limewash on near black. Its floor and bed label locks directly beneath in Söhne Medium caps at 18 px on 22 px, tracked 220 units, a fifth the size: PLASTER, THIRD FLOOR, KING. In the room list the same name runs 72 px on 76 px.

scale.sample: Cold light, plaster, oak and brass
scale.note: Amenity heading, set at the delivered 56 px on 62 px.

scale.sample: A fourteen-room hotel in a converted harbour warehouse.
scale.note: Supporting lines, running text and amenities. Measure held to 65 characters.
Rates sit at 18 px and never grow past the room name above them. The drop label shares this 18 px size but takes Söhne Medium caps tracked 220 units.

type_system.signature_move: A one word room name in limewash on near black at 96 px with its floor and bed label locked directly beneath in Söhne Medium caps at 18 px, tracked 220 units, a fifth the size, so the drop between them is the first thing a viewer notices. Step 01 carries the name, and the 18 px tracked caps of step 04 carry the label.
rules: Never set a rate larger than its room name.
The room name is one word, limewash on near black.
The floor and bed label locks directly beneath the room name at a fifth its size, in Söhne Medium caps tracked 220 units.
Room names and display lines set in Zodiak Light; running text, amenities and rates set in Söhne.

palette_rules.distribution: Near-black ink #14161A is the ground of the booking hero and the amenity panel and the field behind every room name. Limewash plaster #E7E2D8 is the only other ground or panel, as on nordhaven_room_card_2025.pdf. Every room name is Limewash plaster on Near-black ink; other type on Near-black ink is Limewash plaster, and type on Limewash plaster is Near-black ink. Harbour slate, Oak and Brass are accents for hairline rules, dividers and icons only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground, a panel or any type.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: type sits on a solid Near-black ink or Limewash plaster ground or panel, beside the photograph or over it as a solid block, never directly on photographic pixels.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons; no drop shadow or gradient on any of them, since every palette colour is used solid; nothing cheerful or saturated, as the brand note asks.
palette_rules.photography: Apart from the main room photograph on the booking hero, which stays true colour with no tint, tone or overlay, every photograph on every output, amenity cut-outs included, carries the same one committed tone, restrained and cold as the brand is, never cheerful or saturated. The two visits are brought onto one base before that tone is committed, and the tone may change colour and contrast but never what a subject or material is.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
